reason: Stream Y: project-knowledge relevance, retuned toward recall, plus knowledge.search for provider tool turns. knowledge_rerank.py: pinned local cross-encoder (mxbai-rerank-xsmall-v1, HTTPS by commit, size+SHA-256 verified, background preparation, onnxruntime), candidate_scores (question plus every planned search, bounded), an asymmetric gate for knowledge attached unasked (best chunk unless confidently unrelated, strict line for further chunks, embedding-supported rescues), relevance labels for explicit searches, and a no-subject pre-gate. chat.py: _retrieve gates automatic attachment and ranks explicit searches (harness_knowledge_search), planning is skipped for subject-less messages, retrieval runs in a worker thread, knowledge.search is offered to tool turns whenever the project's knowledge may reach the model and is rebuilt on resume, routing guidance tells the model to search. knowledge_search.py + runtime_platform knowledge_search_components (LOCAL_READ analysis tool, cloud models never see local-only sources, bounded output), RETRIEVAL_TOOL_NAMES, harness gateway results carry the label, ChromaKnowledgeIndex carries the reranker and reports it, the CLI wires it. Selected: reranker and knowledge.search tests, knowledge index/ingest tests, chat/reference-material/conversation-search/turn-preflight/chat-queue tests (retrieval during preparation), harness knowledge nodes, and every file asserting exact tool spec sets for tool turns (tool catalog, structured results, tool suggestions, chat subagents, tool history memory). Counts from pytest --collect-only.
exclusions: No frontend, native or Playwright tests: no UI, Rust or visible layout change (index-status gains an optional reranker object the UI ignores; the tool renders in the generic tool card). The real-model calibration test (test_the_pinned_model_meets_its_calibration) is skipped unless NEBULA_TEST_RERANKER_DIR holds the pinned files, so CI never downloads the model; run locally: lexical 14/14, paraphrase 14/15, unrelated 11/13. Operator help retrieval, missions and conversation.search ranking are unchanged. Real-Core evidence is in the PR body. No full suite.
